findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "audit_ai_visibility" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Deep-audit a brand's visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews). FREE TIER: 1 full deep audit per email — pass your email to unlock it. DEVELO…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_ai_visibility · Public sink: audit_ai_visibility · Destructive: audit_ai_visibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_ai_visibility · Public sink: audit_ai_visibility · Destructive: audit_ai_visibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
